# vendor/

Third-party browser files, copied verbatim from npm packages by `npm run build`
(see `build.js`). They are committed so the site works on plain static hosting
(GitHub Pages) with no build step.

| File | npm package | License |
| ---- | ----------- | ------- |
| `online-verifier.global.js` | [`@credenceid/online-verifier`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@credenceid/online-verifier) `dist/index.global.js` (v0.2.0) | ISC (Credence ID) |
| `qrcode.js` | [`qrcode-generator`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator) (v1.4.4) | MIT |

To refresh: `npm install` then `npm run build`.
